title: The General's Shadow (miniquest)
start: Speak to the ghost of General Khazard wandering near the road south-east of Rellekka, while wearing a ring of visibility, ghostly robes and a way to speak with ghosts.

items.t: 40 coins (70 coins if using boat to Karamja)
Ghostspeak amulet or cramulet (not necessary with hard Morytania achievements completed)

recommended.t: Traveller's necklace to teleport to the Outpost south of the Grand Tree
Amulet of glory for teleport to Shantay Pass (Al Kharid option)
Skills necklace for teleport to the Fishing Guild
Waterskins or an enchanted water tiara for the desert heat if you have not yet completed Crocodile Tears

rewards.t: The Shadow sword, which can be reclaimed from the ghost that will appear after Bouncer's defeat for free.

After completion of Fate of the Gods and Ritual of the Mahjarrat, if you visit the Empyrean Citadel throne room and attempt to leave, Sliske will appear and answer one question, before giving you a gift: the ability to see into the Shadow Realm without the ring of visibility. This still happens after Sliske's Endgame.

steps.t: Equip all ghostly robe outfit, the ring of visibility and a ghostspeak amulet or cramulet.

South of the Fremennik Province lodestone and just south-west of the swaying tree, find and then talk to the ghost of General Khazard. [Chat: 1 Uh, well, you don't really have eyes, so how can you tell? › Accept]

sub.t: Khazard, and all of the ghost scouts you'll locate next, cannot be seen on the minimap and have a fair-sized wander radius.
It is recommended to use the skybox bloodstone if the player has completed The Lord of Vampyrium quest but can be done without, or use High Contrast Mode under Accessibility Options.

steps.t: Talk to Sin Seer in Seers' Village. She is upstairs in the spinning wheel house. [Chat: 1 Bribe › 1 Here's the money.]
Talk to the ghost scout south-east of Tai Bwo Wannai (search between the hardwood grove and the drakolith mine).
Talk to the ghost scout south of the Tree Gnome Stronghold entrance (east of the Outpost).
Talk to the ghost scout in the area between Falador and Draynor Manor.
Talk to the ghost scout south of the Shantay Pass.
Prepare for battle before fighting against a level 91 enemy.
Enter the goblin cave east of the Fishing Guild.
Run to the northeast "room" and enter the crack in the southern wall. [Chat: 1 Yes]
Kill the Bouncer. You'll throw the severed leg when its health reaches 0.

sub.t: If Bouncer's health is stuck at 0, the player should leave the room, dismiss any familiars, and reenter to try killing Bouncer again. Once at 0 health, continue clicking on him until your character automatically throws the severed leg.

p: Throwing the severed leg to distract Bouncer
